overall: Wednesday brings mostly sunny skies after patchy morning fog burns off by 11am, with south winds of 0 to 10 mph providing continued marine influence along the coast. A Heat Advisory is in effect for LA County Inland Coast including Downtown LA from 10am Wednesday through Friday evening, with expected highs of 82-94°F inland; however, coastal Los Angeles will remain considerably more moderate. A Wind Advisory (NW winds 20-35 mph, gusts to 50 mph) expires early Wednesday morning at 8am PDT and is not expected to significantly impact daytime temperatures.
